alternatives_rejected.why: A pure delay would shift caller-observed p50 broadly, but inbound p50 rose only 1.16x while p90 spiked ~167x and errors went 0->0.109 (E1, E2). That tail-plus-errors shape matches retransmits and dropped requests.

The socket deviation (z=24.36) is far smaller than the latency deviation (z=358.88) (E1), and no connection or socket error logs appear; only INFO lines (E3, E4). It is more likely a side effect of retransmissions.
The mem deviation (z=19.48) is modest (E1), and own span self-time is flat at 0.19->0.2ms (E2), so there is no sign of in-process slowdown.
The all-services metric ranking surfaces only emailservice (E1), and logs show only normal emailservice INFO traffic (E3).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the network fault on emailservice pods: check tc/netem rules, CNI, and the node NIC, and reschedule the pods to a healthy node if needed. Meanwhile, add client-side retries with backoff and timeouts in checkoutservice for the email calls.
